value.rationale: Theorem 2.4 is meant to certify wovenness from a quantitative perturbation test. The failure is not a cosmetic constant: all printed hypotheses hold while a weave loses an entire coordinate. The example also isolates a general redundancy mechanism by which componentwise l2 control can underestimate a synthesis error by an arbitrarily large square-root factor, giving a concrete design constraint for corrected perturbation theorems.
